# CHASE - Mr. K. Bolch - DREAMER 16, PDF p.5 (printed p.3) for 0200-04F0, PDF p.4 (printed p.2,
# "Chase (Cont from Page 3)") for 0500-05F0.  Load 0200-05FF, run C000 FN 3.
# Needs M.J. Bauer's joystick controller (DREAMER 3): his service routine is included at 0200-0263
# (VC = X 0-3F, VD = Y 0-1F).  Clear all the dots while avoiding the monsters; you are the square
# with the dot in the centre.  Clearing a dot on the extreme left or right halves the monsters' speed.
# 0080-00A2 is used as a scratch pad.
